items.title: After the floods, Nepal’s survivors face the uncertainty of starting over
items.blurb: With homes destroyed, families shattered and winter approaching, thousands of displaced people remain caught between unsafe villages and temporary shelters.

items.title: Private sector bears bulk of Bhotekoshi flood losses
items.blurb: A preliminary government assessment estimates damage and economic losses at Rs408 billion. Nearly 4,800 businesses and 7,570 homes were damaged, while 13 hydropower projects and five solar plants were hit.

items.title: Flood survivors face water shortages, disease risk in crowded holding centres
items.blurb: More than 3,600 people are staying in 37 holding centres across Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading districts. No major outbreak has been reported, but cases of colds, coughs and viral fever are common.

items.title: Nepal begins overhaul of school curriculum, with AI and indigenous knowledge in focus
items.blurb: Nationwide consultations seek to reshape Nepal’s school curriculum by integrating AI, disaster preparedness, entrepreneurship and indigenous knowledge.

items.title: India approves additional 654 MW power exports to Nepal
items.blurb: The additional supply is expected to help Nepal manage winter power shortages after floods damaged hydropower plants and transmission infrastructure.

items.title: Finance Minister Wagle to visit India on September 17-18
items.blurb: The two-day visit will be the first high-level visit from Nepal to India since the August 26 floods devastated parts of the country.

items.title: Himalayas approaching tipping point, millions of livelihoods at stake: Report
items.blurb: Faster glacier melt is threatening water security and increasing the risk of glacial lake floods across the Hindu Kush-Himalaya, putting millions of people downstream at risk.

items.title: US approves $1m forensic support for Nepal flood victim identification
items.blurb: The new funding takes US humanitarian, health and forensic assistance following the floods to more than $5 million.

items.title: Beijing to ban drone possession, storage from November 15
items.blurb: The new rules are part of a broader push to tighten airspace security, with limited exemptions for emergency, research, industrial and other authorised operations.

items.title: Flood blocks Jajarkot-Dolpa road, sweeps away homes and shops
items.blurb: Torrential rain triggered flooding in Jajarkot’s Nalgad area, disrupting transport on the Bheri Corridor and destroying homes, businesses and other structures.

items.title: Nepal tunnel survivor finds solace in village homecoming
items.blurb: Rescued after nine days trapped in a hydropower tunnel, Sanjay Sah returned to his family in a village still mourning workers missing after last month’s disaster.

items.title: Beijing signals support for rebuilding flood-ravaged Rasuwagadhi route
items.blurb: Nepal has sought Chinese assistance to rebuild the 16-km Syaphrubesi-Rasuwagadhi road, while the government prepares a temporary track to restore access to the border crossing.

items.title: Infrastructure Minister Sunil Lamsal on rebuilding after the Bhotekoshi floods
items.blurb: The infrastructure development minister discusses plans for resettlement, damaged roads and bridges, the China border crossing and efforts to build safer settlements for disaster-prone communities.

items.title: Why Nepal’s climate crisis is also a public-health emergency
items.blurb: The Bhotekoshi flood shows why Nepal’s climate crisis must also be understood as a public-health crisis.

items.title: Vehicles cross Krishnabhir on Sunday in trial run after 11 days
items.blurb: Around 20 vehicles, including a stranded gas tanker and heavy trucks, were allowed through the temporary track, but regular traffic will take several more days to resume.

items.title: At least 129 missing after Indonesian passenger ship capsizes
items.blurb: Crews managed to rescue 108 people from ​the stricken Virgo Transport 8 ship and were still searching for any other survivors, the rescue agency added.

items.title: The search dog helping find bodies buried by Nepal’s floods
items.blurb: Samba, a Labrador trained to detect the scent of human remains, has helped rescuers locate around 20 bodies beneath mud and debris since the floods hit Rasuwa.

items.title: Rescuers searching for 140 people from Indonesia passenger ship, official says
items.blurb: Rough seas complicate rescue as authorities search for passengers still unaccounted for.

items.title: India sends three Bailey bridges to restore flood-hit connectivity
items.blurb: The first consignment of components for a 70-metre bridge has reached Hetauda, with the structures to be deployed in flood-hit Nuwakot.

items.title: Trapped nine days in a dark tunnel, Nepali man tells his survival story
items.blurb: Rescued after 10 days underground, Sanjay Sah says prayer, hope and thoughts of his family helped him endure the darkness, hunger and injuries.
